end
function t1.value68(p48, p49)
    local v140 = tick() + 300

    while v140 > tick() do
        local v141 = t1.value13("https://p.savenow.to/ajax/progress.php?id=" .. tostring(p48))

        if v141 then
            local v142 = t1.value14(v141)

            if v142 then
                local v143 = tonumber(v142.progress) or 0
                local clamp = math.clamp
                local v145 = v143 > 100 and math.floor(v143 / 10)

                if not v145 then
                    v145 = math.floor(v143)
                end

                local v146 = clamp(v145, 0, 100)

                if p49 then
                    p49(v146)
                end

                if v143 >= 1000 and v142.download_url then
                    return v142.download_url, v142
                end

                local error = v142.error

                if error then
                    error = v142.error ~= ""
                end

                if error then
                    return nil, v142.error
                end
            end
        end

        task.wait(1.5)
    end

    return nil, "Timeout"
end

    return false, "Download failed"
end
